mapper.select: SELECT T.TRAVEL_NO AS travelNo , T.REGION_NO AS regionNo , T.TRAVEL_NAME AS travelName , T.TRAVEL_STATUS AS travelStatus , T.TRAVEL_ADDRESS AS travelAddress , T.MAP_X AS mapX , T.MAP_Y AS mapY , T.COUNT AS count , T.TRAVEL_IMAGE AS travelImage , R.REGION_NAME AS regionName , T.TRAVEL_CONTENT AS travelContent FROM TB_TRAVEL T LEFT JOIN TB_REGION R ON T.REGION_NO = R.REGION_NO ORDER BY T.TRAVEL_NO DESC

SELECT T.TRAVEL_NO AS travelNo , T.REGION_NO AS regionNo , T.TRAVEL_NAME AS travelName , T.TRAVEL_STATUS AS travelStatus , T.TRAVEL_ADDRESS AS travelAddress , T.MAP_X AS mapX , T.MAP_Y AS mapY , T.COUNT AS count , T.TRAVEL_IMAGE AS travelImage , R.REGION_NAME AS regionName , T.TRAVEL_CONTENT AS travelContent
FROM TB_TRAVEL T LEFT JOIN TB_REGION R ON T.REGION_NO = R.REGION_NO WHERE T.TRAVEL_NO = #{travelNo}

SELECT TRAVEL_NO AS travelNo , REGION_NO AS regionNo , TRAVEL_NAME AS travelName , TRAVEL_CONTENT AS travelContent , TRAVEL_ADDRESS AS travelAddress , MAP_X AS mapX , MAP_Y AS mapY , TRAVEL_IMAGE AS travelImage , TRAVEL_STATUS AS travelStatus , COUNT AS count FROM TB_TRAVEL WHERE TRAVEL_NO = #{travelNo}

SELECT T.* , R.REGION_NAME AS regionName FROM TB_TRAVEL T LEFT JOIN TB_REGION R ON T.REGION_NO = R.REGION_NO WHERE T.MAP_X BETWEEN #{minX} AND #{maxX} AND T.MAP_Y BETWEEN #{minY} AND #{maxY} ORDER BY T.TRAVEL_NO DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TRAVEL WHERE TRAVEL_NAME = #{title}
